catalogNote: The Creator catalog contains all six current approved roads. The two entries here retain original natural/man-made construction details and historical source provenance.
approvalScope: User-selected visual reference examples: road treatment, decorations, themed obstacles and event venues. Not performance approval or approval of rejected colour experiments.
baseWorld: Current Sunlit/Journey forest; preserve road and tree structure.

references.paletteNote: These colours identify the restored reference only; other natural themes choose their own palette.

sourceMap.KnightRush.html: Named renderers/integration above; ROAD_LAB_CASES, JOURNEY_ROAD_THEMES and event lifecycle.
sourceMap.assets/forest/journey-forest.js: Sunlit Journey adapter: materialTargets, world-distance palettes, continuous sky palette, floor/scenery integration and shared ground masking.
sourceMap.assets/forest/sunlit-forest.js: Existing native trees, leaves, props, floor shapes, projection/clipping and bounded drawing caches. Root renderer is drawMorningRoot exposed as KRSunlitArt.root.
sourceMap.assets/forest/disco-grove.js: Thin compatibility adapter projecting the existing Disco floor through KRSunlitArt; not a separate art implementation.

auditNote: Choose relevant tests and inspect which renderer/style each exercises. Legacy/classic tests do not replace a current Sunlit/Journey scene check. Screenshots in output are test evidence, not automatically approved references.
